data.title: Binghatti Ruby
data.about:
Binghatti RUBY at JVC is a stunning new residential development by Binghatti Developers, offering luxurious apartments in the heart of Dubai’s Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). This elegant high-rise boasts a striking façade inspired by the ruby gemstone, combining innovative design with timeless sophistication. The Binghatti RUBY apartments feature modern interiors with high-quality finishes, providing a refined living experience for residents.

With breathtaking views of the city skyline, the location offers tranquility and convenience. Residents can enjoy a range of world-class amenities of Binghatti RUBY, designed to elevate the lifestyle experience. The floor plans of Binghatti RUBY are thoughtfully designed to maximize space and comfort, catering to diverse preferences. The Binghatti RUBY master plan ensures a harmonious community with everything you need within reach. Whether you're looking for comfort or elegance, Binghatti RUBY at JVC presents an ideal choice for your next home.

characteristics_module.title: Experience exclusive amenities, a prime location, and modern designs from Binghatti RUBY
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Binghatti RUBY at JVC is located in the vibrant Jumeirah Village Circle. It offers seamless access to major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, making it ideal for commuters.
  • Luxury Living: The high-rise apartments feature modern, spacious layouts with top-notch finishes, offering residents a sophisticated living experience with stunning city skyline views.
  • World-Class Amenities: Residents can enjoy a range of premium amenities, including a fully equipped gym, swimming pool, landscaped gardens, and more, designed to enhance comfort and convenience.
  • Strategic Connectivity: The development is near key landmarks such as the Mall of Emirates, Dubai Mall, and Dubai International Airport, ensuring easy access to shopping, entertainment, and travel hubs.
  • Family-Friendly Community: Located in a family-oriented neighborhood, Binghatti RUBY at JVC provides a peaceful environment with retail outlets, schools, and recreational options nearby.

location_tile.title: Where Urban Convenience Meets Suburban Tranquility—Live at Binghatti RUBY in JVC!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Binghatti RUBY at JVC is strategically located in the vibrant Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a perfect blend of urban living and suburban tranquillity. The Binghatti RUBY location provides easy access to major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, ensuring seamless connectivity to the rest of Dubai. The community has amenities, including retail outlets, dining options, and recreational facilities. With thoughtfully designed floor plans and a comprehensive master plan, Binghatti RUBY apartments cater to modern living needs in an ideal location.

  • 05 Minutes to Circle Mall, JVC
  • 10 Minutes to Dubai Butterfly Garden
  • 15 Minutes to the Mall of Emirates
  • 20 Minutes to Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall
  • 28 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 30 Minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
